title: Why can I not override a file or Telegram limit
question: Why can I not override a file or Telegram limit?
answer: A judgement-call warning can be allowed, but a file that Telegram would reject still has to meet its technical limits. An empty cell with no picture also cannot become a usable sticker through an override. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: The check category says File or Telegram limit.
